customManagers.description: Bump the digest-pinned data-plane image (DEFAULT_IMAGE) in the control-plane code and the deploy examples. The reference is digest-only (@sha256:...), so we tell Renovate which tag's digest to follow via currentValueTemplate (the rolling :latest tag published by build-image).

packageRules.description: Data-plane image: pin/update by immutable digest only. A human MUST merge (never auto-apply a new image to a school's live RADIUS).
